quote: Jacobi wondered if the same is true for sums of four cubes
note: Jacobi posed this as a question in 1851 based on Zacharias Dase's computational tables of sums of cubes. While Jacobi's formulation appears to be the earliest documented instance in accessible academic literature, the original proposer of the conjecture in its modern form remains unclear. The problem was formally studied by Richmond (1922), Mordell (1937), and Sierpiński-Schinzel (1959).
